whitelist_criteria.walk_forward_stability: Consistent positive expectancy across Train, Validation, and Out-of-Sample
whitelist_criteria.cost_inclusion: Real broker spread, commission, and adverse slippage included

summary.rationale: No candidate combination met the multi-period stability criteria. Candidates with positive OOS periods (e.g. NAS100 M5/M15, EURUSD M15) showed negative Train/Validation expectancy, indicating regime clustering or sample variance rather than true stationary statistical edge under transaction costs.
